research_subquestion: Under matched small driving-video adaptation and a common planner, are LPWM particle representations a promising planning backbone compared with V-JEPA representations?

recommended_initial_corpus.training_sampling: identical fixed clip identities, timestamps, preprocessing, sample order and exposure checkpoints across backbones

initialization.jepa: official general-video V-JEPA2 ViT-L/16 weights before330h driving adaptation
initialization.jepa_exclude: vitl_merge_3dataset_e50.pt and V-JEPA2.1 distilled model as primary initializations
initialization.lpwm: public Sketchy weights before driving adaptation, same registered rectangular16FG+1BG model
initialization.interpretation: matched downstream driving adaptation of two pretrained representation systems, not isolated SSL-objective or particle-structure causality

stage1.jepa: native V-JEPA masked latent prediction, EMA target and stop-gradient
stage1.lpwm: native temporal ELBO reconstruction and particle context/dynamics priors
stage1.optimizer_state: fresh adaptation optimizer/scheduler/counters, independently verified from pretrained tensor initialization
stage1.code_observation: vendoredVJEPA app/vjepa/utils.py load_checkpoint restores optimizer and epoch; cannot use resume blindly for fresh small-corpus adaptation
stage1.learning_rate: model-appropriate registered short schedules with equal tuning budget, not identical numerical LR by fiat

stage2.planner: same DrivoR-style planner, losses, candidate generation/scorer, supervision and output horizon
stage2.observations: same current+previous front frames, timestamps, resolution and ego status
stage2.backbone_policy: both fine-tuned with matched policy and explicitly reported LR; only necessary input projections differ and their capacity is reported
stage2.training: same navtrain scene subset or full split and registered exposure budget, same effective batch and seed; short pilot schedule independent of prior25epoch warmup
stage2.evaluation: fixed held-out recording dev split for choices; PDMS and components plus scenario breakdown; official navtest after choices fixed
stage2.optional_followup: LPWM frozen vs fine-tuned control and current-only/future interventions for planning-conditioned representation contribution
